title: Make a Discord Bot in 3 Steps!

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing the Discord library and creating our bot with a command prefix.

steps.title: Step 2: Add an Event
steps.explanation: This event lets us know when the bot is successfully connected to Discord.

steps.title: Step 3: Add a Command
steps.explanation: Now we add a simple command that responds with 'Hello!' when someone types '!hello'.

steps.title: Step 4: Run the Bot
steps.explanation: Finally, we run the bot with your Discord bot token. Make sure to keep it secret!

steps.title: Try it Yourself!
steps.explanation: Now you have a working Discord bot. Try it yourself and share your results!

intro_hook: Want to make a Discord bot? Let's do it fast!
